details: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance experienced a massive cyberattack, resulting in the compromise of over $6 billion in digital assets. Following the hack, customers withdrew approximately $3.4 billion from the platform. North Korean state-sponsored cybercrime group, Lazarus Group (also known as TraderTraitor), has been implicated in the theft. South Korea has responded by urging local cryptocurrency exchanges to bolster their security measures, highlighting the country's significant exposure to crypto trading. Binance has pledged to cover all losses, stating that it had covered about 90% of the stolen assets as of early November.
title: Binance Faces $6.3 Billion Crypto Heist Fallout as South Korea Urges Tighter Security

details: Ukraine's drone strikes are reportedly hindering various sectors of the Russian economy, including data centers, refineries, and logistics hubs, according to the Central Bank of Russia. This acknowledgement five years into the conflict highlights the ongoing economic impact of the war. Data from Rosstat indicates an 18% year-on-year drop in refinery output, which is pressuring energy-intensive mining and wholesale trade.
title: Ukraine Drone Strikes Hamper Russian Economy, Central Bank Notes Capacity Issues

details: ING THINK's 2027 FX Outlook identifies several key risks, including a "geopolitical blowout" and "AI stress," which could trigger sharp currency movements. A spillover of the Russia-Ukraine war or escalation of cyber and hybrid attacks on European countries could severely impact European currencies, with the dollar, Swiss franc, and yen seeing rallies as safe havens. Furthermore, the report notes that the resilience of the AI trade in equities has been tested, and a decisive unwind could become a major FX driver next year, with initial dollar underperformance turning into a boost if a broader selloff occurs.
title: Geopolitical Blowout and AI Stress Among Key Risks for FX Markets in 2027
